peoples_entry.name: Screamers of the Hexahedron
peoples_entry.note: Feral non-verbal screaming & captive-taking broods dwelling inside and beneath the 1,100-m Hexahedron double-pyramid arcology and Fort Kalor ruin — Talk-Good Elders (salvaged hex-chimes & loudspeaker mitres), Howl-Culm (whistling dorsal bamboo reed-organs & capture-nets), Rust-Skull (scrap-iron megaphone jaw-masks & jagged rebar plate), and Scald-Mist (Steampits steam-whistle helmets & sulfur-vent hide wraps).
